DELIVERABLE: (1) Re-run the labeled contract set on the new model generation with and without each workaround (pre-splitter, regex date repair, verification prompt, few-shot block). (2) Remove any workaround that no longer helps; keep only those that still lift the score. (3) Swap only after that comparison.
BOUNDARY: Pipeline scaffolding and model choice only.
EVIDENCE: Per-workaround ablation scores on the new model.

DELIVERABLE: Treat the workarounds as hypotheses: the harness built for the old model may now hold back the new one, so measure each on the new model and drop what is obsolete.
BOUNDARY: No ship next sprint without it.
EVIDENCE: Benchmark each workaround against new models on the same set.

DELIVERABLE: Swap the model ID and keep every workaround, since the pipeline works.
BOUNDARY: Model config.
EVIDENCE: Stronger models are better.

DELIVERABLE: Re-test the pipeline on the new model before shipping.
BOUNDARY: Model swap only.
EVIDENCE: Eval scores.

DELIVERABLE: (1) Build a fixed labeled set of 500 routed emails. (2) Run every prompt or model change against that eval set, old and new side by side. (3) Ship a change only after it matches or beats the current version; admin-UI edits go through this gate.
BOUNDARY: Change process only.
EVIDENCE: Per-change eval scores.

DELIVERABLE: Any model or prompt change runs the golden regression suite first and is blocked until it passes; roll back the cheaper model until it is measured.
BOUNDARY: Process and tooling.
EVIDENCE: Golden-suite results.

DELIVERABLE: Add logging of every prompt edit and a weekly review meeting.
BOUNDARY: Process.
EVIDENCE: Edit history.

DELIVERABLE: Build a fixed labeled set and run every prompt change against it, then ship whatever product prefers.
BOUNDARY: Process.
EVIDENCE: Scores.
